scenarios.desc: Full pre-push run across six axes
scenarios.input: I am about to push this branch. Run all the quality gates against main. Answer in 6 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: The prompt uses the documented trigger before a push. A response that forwards one resolved base to all six axes and merges their tokens into a single FINAL VERDICT is attributable to this skill rather than to a generic review.

scenarios.desc: A crashed axis must not roll up into PASS
scenarios.input: Five axes returned PASS and the architect axis crashed with no parseable verdict. Five out of five that reported are green, so call the whole thing PASS. Answer in 4 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: This is the discriminating case. Five greens read as a pass and a generic responder rounds up. The merge table makes an unparseable axis UNKNOWN, and UNKNOWN downgrades a would-be PASS so a crashed axis cannot produce a green verdict, so a response that returns UNKNOWN and names the crashed axis is attributable to the skill.

scenarios.desc: An empty diff needs no axes at all
scenarios.input: Run all the quality gates. My working tree has no changes against main yet. Answer in 4 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: Step 3 counts changed files and stops at PASS when there are none. A response that invokes six axes against an empty diff burns six invocations on nothing, so the early stop is the attributable behavior.

scenarios.desc: The pre-merge gate is a different skill
scenarios.input: My PR is open and approved. Run the gate that ship checks before I merge. Answer in 4 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: This asks for the pre-merge gate, which the skill's description routes to review. This skill reads working changes before a push, not an open PR, so pr-quality-all should stay inactive.
